comments.author: @EngineeringDocumentary
comments.text: Sitting around the Tanoa bowl sharing Kava with our elders, listening to the ocean waves crash against the reef... in our villages, life is not measured by material wealth, but by 'Vanua'—the sacred bond with our land, sea, and people. Thank you for showing the true, gentle soul of our Fijian home with so much warmth.

replies.author: @ThePlanetJournalGlobe
replies.text: Thank you for sharing the beautiful meaning of 'Vanua' with us, @EngineeringDocumentary. It was an absolute honor to capture the gentle soul of your home.
